title: Hot air balloon with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="balloonGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF6B6B"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#E84545"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C0392B"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB347"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="30" ry="34" fill="url(#balloonGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Vertical stripes on balloon for decoration -->
  <path d="M30 10 Q35 38 30 70" fill="none" stroke="#FF9F9F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M50 4 Q50 38 50 72" fill="none" stroke="#FFD4D4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M70 10 Q65 38 70 70" fill="none" stroke="#FF9F9F" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="22" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#FFAAAA" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Face on the balloon -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="34" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#1A0A0A"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="34" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#1A0A0A"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="32" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="32" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 46 Q50 56 60 46" fill="none" stroke="#1A0A0A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="44" r="4" fill="#FFB3B3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="44" r="4" fill="#FFB3B3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Basket ropes -->
  <line x1="35" y1="70" x2="38" y2="83" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="70" x2="62" y2="83" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="72" x2="44" y2="83" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="72" x2="56" y2="83" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Basket -->
  <rect x="36" y="83" width="28" height="12" rx="2" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="36" y="83" width="28" height="3" rx="1" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="89" x2="64" y2="89" stroke="#6B4226" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="83" x2="42" y2="95" stroke="#6B4226" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="83" x2="50" y2="95" stroke="#6B4226" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="83" x2="58" y2="95" stroke="#6B4226" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Small burner glow between balloon and basket -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="6" ry="3" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
